title: BioNutriGPT Stage 2 Three-Arm Comparative Added-Value Study
research_question: Does model-guided optimization add measurable engineering value beyond simpler ways of constructing nutrient targets?
sample_source: Reserved disjoint NHANES temporal cohort from Saved Model/stage2_comparison_design_v1

shared_envelope_policy.activity_assumption: sedentary (PAL = 1.20) uniformly across all participants and arms
shared_envelope_policy.energy_prescription: Mifflin-St Jeor BMR * 1.20 with -500 kcal deficit if baseline predicted obesity >= 0.50; floor 1200 kcal; bounds [0.95*T_kcal, 1.05*T_kcal]
shared_envelope_policy.condition_flags: Baseline calibrated probabilities >= 0.50 trigger branch-specific envelopes (e.g. CVD sodium <= 1500mg, potassium >= 3500mg, fat <= 6%; Diabetes carb <= 45%, fiber floor >= 35g)
shared_envelope_policy.immutable_features: Non-dietary biological, demographic, and lifestyle features strictly preserved (candidate[fixed] == raw[fixed])
linear_constraints: Thermodynamic energy balance: 4*PROT + 4*CARB + 9*TFAT + 7*ALCO == KCAL +- 1% (+-0.99% projection margin)
Saturated-to-unsaturated fat ratio: SFAT / (MFAT + PFAT + 0.1) <= max(base_sat_to_unsat, 0.4)
shared_envelope_policy.closed_loop_gate: Delta p = p_cand - p_0 <= 0.0015 across diabetes, obesity, and CVD rescored through frozen calibrated Stage 1 model

A_rules_only.name: Deterministic Rules-Only Nutrient Targets
A_rules_only.method: Closed-form clinical target construction derived strictly from dietary guidelines, AMDRs, and DRI references
A_rules_only.description: Sets energy to T_kcal; protein to 1.0 g/kg (bounded by [0.8W, 2.0W]); fat to 25% (or 30% under diabetes); carb by thermodynamic energy balance; fiber to guideline floor; sugar to min(10% energy, ratio cap); saturated fat to 5-7% energy (capped by ratio); MUFA/PUFA by fat breakdown; sodium/potassium to guideline targets capped by ratio; alcohol to 0.0; non-essential carotenoids/caffeine/synthetic folate to 0.0; all other vitamins/minerals set to age/sex DRI RDA/AI reference lower bounds. Uses baseline probabilities solely to define the common routing envelope.

B_minimum_change.name: Minimum-Change Joint Constraint Projection
B_minimum_change.method: Convex quadratic projection of observed nutrient intake vector onto the joint feasible polytope using fixed engineering scales
B_minimum_change.optimizer: SLSQP with HiGHS LP feasibility witness warm-start
B_minimum_change.objective: min 0.5 * sum_{i=0}^{38} ((n_i - n_obs_i) / s_i)^2 subject to tightened bounds and linear constraints
B_minimum_change.fallback_behavior: If SLSQP fails to converge or produces residuals > 1e-6, return verified LP feasibility witness flagged feasible_lp_fallback and minimum_distance_not_established
B_minimum_change.description: Finds the closest mathematically feasible target to what the participant currently eats without model-guided loss or risk gradients.

C_model_guided.name: Full Model-Guided Optimization + Joint Projection
C_model_guided.method: 50-step Adam search on multi-objective counterfactual risk loss followed by identical scale-normalized joint projection
C_model_guided.optimizer: PyTorch Adam (lr=0.05, 50 steps) + SLSQP QP projection
C_model_guided.objective: Step 1: 50-step Adam minimizing 2*p_cvd + 2*p_diab + 1*p_obes + 50*ReLU(p-p0) + 0.001*||delta_N||^2 + barrier. Step 2: Scale-normalized convex quadratic projection onto the joint feasible polytope.
C_model_guided.fallback_behavior: Identical LP fallback if SLSQP post-projection fails.
C_model_guided.description: Frozen deployed Stage 2 implementation evaluated under identical common envelope.

endpoints.primary: All-check acceptance rate (proportion of cases meeting all 39 bounds, energy balance, 3 ratios, Filter 2 invariants, and closed-loop score gate)
secondary: Numerical feasibility rate (proportion satisfying all numerical constraints)
Closed-loop score gate pass rate (Delta p <= 0.0015 on all 3 outcomes)
Scale-normalized distance from observed intake: sqrt(sum(((n* - n_obs)/s)^2))
Nutrient shifts in major dietary components (KCAL, PROT, CARB, TFAT, SODI, POTA)
Per-outcome risk probability changes (Delta p_diabetes, Delta p_obesity, Delta p_cvd)

comparisons.purpose: Isolates the specific value of model-guided Adam search beyond minimum-change projection
Evaluates full model-guided pipeline against deterministic clinical rules
Evaluates minimum-change projection against deterministic clinical rules

statistical_analysis_plan.methodology: Participant-level paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, fixed random seed 20261123). Reports absolute differences in percentage points and paired 95% percentile confidence intervals [2.5%, 97.5%].
statistical_analysis_plan.multiplicity_handling: Hierarchical testing order: Primary contrast (Arm C vs Arm B) tested first at alpha=0.05. Secondary contrasts interpreted with Bonferroni-adjusted alpha=0.025.
statistical_analysis_plan.missing_data_policy: All 100 attempted profiles are retained in primary denominators (intention-to-treat equivalent). No failed cases are dropped or replaced with defaults.
statistical_analysis_plan.interpretation_rules: Confidence intervals containing zero do not establish clinical or engineering equivalence. Model score improvements evaluated with the optimization model are self-referential and do not prove health benefit.
statistical_analysis_plan.p_values: Exact two-sided binomial test of discordant paired binary outcomes; primary alpha .05; two secondary acceptance contrasts Bonferroni alpha .025. Other endpoints exploratory; pointwise percentile bootstrap intervals.

downstream_stage3_scope: Clearly excluded from this experiment. Stage 3 integer meal planning is not evaluated.
invalidation_conditions: Source or checkpoint hashes do not match protocol bindings
Non-identical envelopes or participant metadata across arms
Any modification to Stage 1 model weights, calibrators, or routing cutoffs
Silent substitution of missing results with favorable defaults
amendment: Post-result correction: one Adam invocation, consistent Filter 2 tolerance, exact paired binary tests, paired mean-distance bootstrap. Same participants/targets construction; not a new independent validation sample.
timing: Single search, CUDA synchronized at boundaries, common inference/evaluation included, model loading excluded, untimed inference warmup; descriptive single-run timings with fixed A/B/C order.
